An outline zooms out on each downbeat. Changes fade in. Colours: one hue against two. Pace: driving, pulsing on every beat, moving at half time.

Section B, new, from the Northern lights recipe. Ribbons, with flow field at the start of loud phrases. A torus knot is the centrepiece. Flow field only in its glass. A 6-way rippling kaleidoscope folds the glow, turning. Ribbons faster and bigger than usual. Sparkles pop on the stabs. Changes cut in on the bar line. Colours: three far-apart hues. Pace: steady, pulsing every other beat, moving at normal speed.

Sparkles pop on the stabs. Changes cut in on the bar line. Colours: one hue against two. Pace: driving, pulsing on every beat, moving at half time.
